name: neo-statusline
description: One-line status bar under the prompt: model, effort, git, context, prompt cache, subagents, rate limits, cost.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: Lifetime of the prompt cache: auto infers it from cache hits after a pause, or force 5m / 1h.

showLimits.title: Show subscription limits
showLimits.description: Show the 5h and 7d subscription rate-limit windows. Turn off if another tool already shows them.
